title: Change values in two places of a config
prompt: In config.json set server.port to 8081 and set logging.level to "debug". Change nothing else.
verify:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
c = json.load(open('config.json'))
assert c['server']['port'] == 8081, c
assert c['logging']['level'] == 'debug', c
assert c['server']['host'] == '127.0.0.1' and c['logging']['file'] == 'app.log' and c['features'] == ['a', 'b'], c
print('ok')
PY
